resources.string: Could not load your devices. Tap to retry.
Comma uses Bluetooth to find your device and set it up. It is only used while you add a device.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to find your device.
Plug in your Comma device. A new device with a screen says “Hello” on it. To set up a device again, hold its button for 3 seconds, then let go.
No devices found yet. Keep the device close to your phone and make sure it is in pairing mode. A device with a screen says “Hello” or “Pairing mode”.

If %1$s shows a 6-digit code, your phone asks for it in a pairing request. If the request shows up as a notification, tap Pair & connect, then type the code. A device without a screen pairs on its own; accept the request if your phone shows one.
Pick the network %1$s should use at home.
Could not search for networks. Try again.
Could not find “%1$s”. Make sure it is a 2.4 GHz network in range.
How this device appears in Comma.
Keep your phone close until this finishes.
%1$s is online. You can find it under Devices.
%1$s saved its settings but is not online yet. This can take a minute; check back under Devices.
Could not connect. Keep the device close and make sure it is still in pairing mode.
Pairing did not finish. If the device showed a code, check it and try again.
The connection to the device dropped.
The device did not accept its settings.
The device could not save its settings.
The device did not come online. Check that the Wi-Fi network has internet access.
Could not reach Comma. Check your connection.
Comma could not create the device’s access. Try again later.
Your account cannot add devices to this workspace.
This workspace has too many voice keys. Remove a device first.
Comma refused the device’s access. Hold its button for 3 seconds and set it up again.
This phone could not store the device’s access, so setup stopped. Try again.
%1$s loses its access to Comma. Then reset it: hold its button for 10 seconds until it restarts.
It was set up from another phone, so it can still reconnect until you reset it.
Could not remove the device. Please try again.
Device removed. Hold its button for 10 seconds to reset it.
Lets Comma act through this device. Off keeps it read-only.
Comma will be able to send requests on your local network through this device.
The device didn’t confirm the change. Try again.
The device didn’t answer in time. Try again.
Your account can’t change this device’s access.
This device is no longer in your workspace.
Comma couldn’t change the device’s access. Try again later.
